summary: Blackboard: the course bar folds into its pill and back without jitter, on slower Macs and with Safari's bounce. Blackboard: opening a folder, a learning module or a menu no longer makes the page jump or throws away Glaze's saved copies of your pages. Blackboard Messages: Reply stays on screen under Glaze's top bar. Blackboard Activity: each item's name comes first, in bold, with its course under it. Blackboard: text left bare on your Look's background (SafeAssign, an assignment's Additional Information, the Courses and Organizations toolbars, Activity's filters, Grades, Messages, the roster filter and the Dashboard bar) gets a surface you can read, and To Do's ticks show. Blackboard on a shared computer: another student's course no longer shows as a blank card, each student gets their own first Dashboard cards, and Reset layout moves every course card you see. Open Blackboard on the dashboard never takes over a page you opened by its link, and goes there without loading the page again. To Do no longer redraws every minute when nothing in it changed. Writer in Safari: typing fast no longer loses a word's last letters or moves the caret back. macOS's inline predictions are off in Writer, which has its own gray text. Safari: Google Drive and Calendar keep working after Google refuses an expired sign-in while other requests are waiting for it.
